## Riotblood (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
CE Tiny undead (swarm)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft.; Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)  
**hp** 7 (2d8-2)  
**Fort** +0, **Ref** +3, **Will** +4  
**Immune** swarm traits, undead immunities  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Space** 10 ft.  
**Melee** swarm (1d8 piercing plus 1 bleed plus enraging distraction)  
**Special Attacks** enraging distraction (Fort DC 11)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 9, **Dex** 16, **Con** -, **Int** -, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** -3; **CMD** 10 (cannot be tripped)  


**Special Abilities**


**Enraging Distraction (Ex)** Creatures that succumb to the riotblood’s distraction special quality are affected as if by rage for one round, rather than nauseated as normal for the distraction special quality.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary or gangs of up to 2d4 riotblood swarms  
**Treasure** incidental
